newsitem.title: GHANA: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
GHANA, Dec 16 to 30 - Tema, Takoradi - No waiting time. No work in port on 25/12. Work at ports on 26/12 and 1/1/97 will be on double rate overtime.

ISRAEL, Dec 17 - Haifa - Five vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. Loading discharging at berth, 5 general cargo, 1 bulk, 4 containers, 1 car carrier, 1 tanker. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 1 bulk, 1 container. 3 Vessels under repair, 4 awaiting orders. Ashdod - Two to three days delay expected. Loading/discharging at berth, 10 general cargo, 2 bulk, 2 container vessels. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 7 general cargo, 1 bulk, 1 container vessel. Eilat - Loading/discharging at berth, 1 bulk, 1 container vessel, 1 passenger vessel.

NIGERIA, Dec 13 - Lagos - Port is currently congested due to dredging operations and berthing delays occurring to product tankers. No berthing delays reported to general cargo vessels. The congestion should clear within 5 days. Port Harcourt - No berthing delays reported, all crude terminals loading according to programme.

TUNISIA, Dec 14 - Sfax - Four vessels operating of which 1 discharging gas, 1 loading bulk rock phosphate, 1 loading bulk tsp, 1 loading bulk salt. Tunis - Five vessels in port of which 1 awaiting instructions, 1 general cargo, 1 marble chips, 1 marble blocks, 1 other vessel. Rades - Three ro/ro vessels in port. Goulette - North side - 3 Vessels in port of which 1 military, 1 general cargo, 1 passenger vessel. South side - 2 Vessels of which 1 discharging grain, 1 loading zinc. One vessel in roads. Sousse - Three vessels in port of which 1 discharging general cargo, 1 loading bulk salt, 1 discharging cotton. No waiting time, no vessels awaiting orders.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, Dec 15 - Dubai - Vessels operating in port 8-14/12 - 77 Containers, 18 general cargo, 4 general cargo/containers, 4 bulkers, 3 car carriers, 19 tankers, 2 naval, 2 bunkers/repairs/stores, 5 dhows, 12 barges, 12 tugs, 23 supply boats, 1 lpg tanker, trawler, 2 chemical tankers. 26 Container vessels due, no delays expected. 5 Containers loading at berth, 1 container under repair/laid up. 15 General cargo vessels due, no delays expected. 4 General cargo loading at berth, 5 discharging. 3 Under repair/laid up. 8 Tankers due, no delays. 1 Tanker loading at berth, 1 discharging, 1 bunkering, 4 under repair/laid up.

YEMEN, Dec 15 - Hodeidah - Vessels berthed, 1 rice, 1 sugar, 2 bulk wheat, 1 timber, 1 container. 2 Vessels awaiting berth at anchorage of which 1 container, 1 general cargo. Berthing delays containers/general cargo 1 day, bagged cargo 2-3 days, bulk wheat/corn 3-4 days. Dec 16 Hodeidah - All berths occupied. 7 Vessels alongside of which 2 bulk wheat, 1 sugar, 1 timber, 1 rice, 2 containers. 2 Vessels anchored of which 1 container, 1 general cargo. Berthing waiting time general cargo up to 2 days, bagged cargo up to 4 days, bulk cargo up to 6 days, containers up to 1 day. Mokha - One vessel alongside discharging wheat flour. No vessels anchored, no berthing waiting time.
